baseline_prompt_en: Create a full-length photorealistic civic-fashion editorial: a nighttime concrete-atrium scene built around a West African grand boubou silhouette during an architecture biennale installation. The subject is the same adult woman shown in the supplied portrait reference. Her facial structure, eye aperture and spacing, nose, lips, jawline, adult age, and long dark hair remain faithfully matched to that reference. She wears a floor-length grand boubou with an ample rectangular body, broad open sleeves, and dense embroidery framing the neck and center front over a coordinated inner wrapper. She catches a falling paper architecture model against one forearm while the opposite sleeve opens into a full drape, making the robe's volume and layered construction readable. Show both sleeve apertures, the continuous shoulder-to-body expanse, embroidered neckline, center-front panel, inner-layer glimpse, and lower hem together. Use full-body architectural framing, luminous concrete, warm installation light, cool skylight spill, natural skin texture, and sharply resolved textile weight.
